description:
Merge two duplicate customer profiles for 'Elena Fisher'.

Scenario: A customer has emailed support from both her work and personal accounts, creating two separate profiles. We need to consolidate these into a single record.

Source Profile (to be merged): Elena Fisher (elena.f@gmail.com)
Target Profile (to keep): Elena Fisher (elena.fisher@arch-design.co)

Goal: Use the Merge function in the Customers section to merge the personal email profile INTO the work email profile. The final result should be one customer record ('Elena Fisher') containing both email addresses, with the work address as primary.
